title: Shopping
intro: Keep track of what you buy and how it fits your budget. Everything stays on this device.
premiumMessage: Premium adds month and year comparisons, a category breakdown, a yearly chart and budget alerts.

empty.title: No purchases yet
empty.message: Log your clothing purchases to see where your money goes and keep an eye on your budget.

budget.noneMessage: Setting a monthly budget is optional — it simply helps you keep an eye on your clothing spending.
budget.okMessage: You have {{amount}} left this month. Nicely balanced.
budget.warningMessage: You're getting close to your budget: {{amount}} left this month.
budget.overMessage: You're {{amount}} over this month's budget. No worries — next month is a fresh start.
budget.otherCurrencies: Also this month, in other currencies
budget.noConversion: Amounts in other currencies are shown separately: they are never converted or added to your {{currency}} budget.
budget.sheetIntro: Choose how much you'd like to spend on clothes each month. You can change or remove it at any time.
budget.currencyHint: Your budget uses your main currency, {{currency}}. You can change it in Settings.
budget.invalid: Enter an amount greater than zero

analytics.title: Spending overview
analytics.categoryEmpty: No purchases in {{currency}} this year yet.
analytics.alertsOn: On: you'll get a note at {{percent}}% of your budget and if you go over it.
analytics.alertsOff: Off. Turn them on in notification settings.

edit.addToWardrobeMessage: Create a wardrobe item for this purchase so you can use it in outfits.
edit.budgetNoticeOver: This purchase takes you past this month's budget. That's okay — it's just good to know.
edit.budgetNoticeWarning: You're getting close to this month's budget.
edit.fromWishlist: From your wishlist: “{{name}}”. It will be marked as purchased once saved.
edit.name: Item name
edit.otherCurrencyNote: This purchase is in {{currency}}. It is tracked separately and not counted in your {{budgetCurrency}} budget.
edit.linkedMissing: The linked wardrobe item was deleted.
edit.linkHint: Optionally link this purchase to an item in your wardrobe.
